settings.question: About the brand
settings.text:
1. Who is Kiggle? 

Kiggle is a parent-run kids' clothing brand from Kolkata, India. The name blends kiss and giggle, capturing warmth and joy. Founded by three friends, Kiggle is committed to quality, comfort, and aesthetics in every outfit. We focus on inclusivity without gender labels, logos, or slogans. Our designs let every child feel free to be themselves. At Kiggle, we believe kids should feel confident, colourful, and comfortable. We’re here to celebrate kids just being kids.

2.Why Kiggle?

Kiggle is committed to making a positive impact on both children and the planet. We follow sustainable manufacturing by using organic fabrics and providing GOTS-certified clothes. Our focus on ethical practices means parents can trust that their choices support a healthier environment. By choosing Kiggle, you choose stylish, accessible, and comfortable apparel that values individuality and a better tomorrow. 

3. What are Kiggle’s sustainability practices?

As parents, we are deeply invested in the future our children will inherit. That’s why we exclusively use organic fabrics and ensure that all our garments are produced using Earth-Mint technology and GOTS-certified facilities. Additionally, we choose plastic-free packaging because we believe in doing our part to protect the planet.

4. What is Earth-Mint Technology and GOTS?

  • Earth-Mint Technology is a sustainable fabric treatment that infuses clothes with natural peppermint oil, giving them antibacterial properties. This process reduces water usage and ensures the fabric stays fresh, soft, and gentle on the skin. At Kiggle, we exclusively use azo-free dyes and 100% organic cotton, making our garments safe, sustainable, and kind to the environment.

  • A GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard) certification ensures fabrics are made with at least 70% organic fibres, following strict sustainable and ethical practices. This means that clothes are safe for kids and kind to the planet.

5. How do you ensure quality?

Our approach is simple: if we wouldn’t dress our own kids in it, we wouldn’t sell it. Each Kiggle garment is crafted to meet the highest quality standards. We take pride in the fact that many of our customers discover us through hand-me-downs, which speaks volumes about how well our clothes stand the test of time.

6. Where can I follow Kiggle?

Join the Kiggle Tribe! Follow us on Facebook and Instagram for updates on new arrivals, sneak-peeks and all things Kiggle

settings.question: Product
settings.text:
1. Why don't you have boys' and girls' sections?

Because clothes don't have genders—and neither do colours! From the beginning, we have designed all our styles to be for every child. We believe in giving kids the freedom to choose what they like. As we continue to grow, we'll be expanding our collection to include more options, such as dresses and PJs, so stay tuned!

2. Why do you offer limited colours in solid options?

We believe in keeping things simple (because parenting is already challenging enough, right?). Instead of following fast-changing trends, we focus on classic, everyday colours that suit all kids. This approach allows us to maintain exceptional quality at a better price and makes shopping easier for busy parents. Do you have a colour or style suggestion? We'd love to hear from you. Drop us a note at hello@kiggle.shop.

3. Do your clothes shrink?

Our clothes are pre-washed to prevent any shrinkage surprises! However, since most of our garments are made from 100% organic cotton, we recommend washing them in cold water and drying them in the shade to keep them looking fresh and in great shape. 

4. How do I know what size to buy?

Each product page features a handy size guide. If you’re still unsure, feel free to email us at hello@kiggle.shop, and we’ll be happy to help you find the perfect fit.

5. What if the item I want is out of stock?

We understand how frustrating that can be! If something you love is out of stock, simply click the "Notify Me" button on the product page, and we'll email you as soon as it's back. Or feel free to contact us at hello@kiggle.shop, and we'll do our best to assist you.

6. Will you make clothes for adults?

At the moment, our focus is on creating the best clothing for kids. However, we do have plans to expand into adult wear, including maternity clothes for moms-to-be and nursing mothers. So, stay tuned for exciting updates!

settings.question: Pricing and Offers
settings.text:
1. How do you offer lower prices without sacrificing quality?

It’s simple—our aim is to make high-quality, sustainable clothing accessible to every child. We avoid flashy marketing and extensive margins, focusing instead on the essentials that provide great value. By keeping things straightforward, we’re able to pass those savings on to you.

2. Do you offer promos or discounts?

Yes, absolutely! Sign up for our emails or texts, and you'll be the first to hear about our exclusive offers. Plus, when you purchase 3 or 5 items from the same collection, we automatically apply a discount—no codes needed.

settings.question: Shipping and Delivery
settings.text:
1. To which locations do you provide shipping?

We currently provide PAN India shipping. Whether in a bustling city or a cosy town, you can expect a seamless delivery with us.

2. How much do you charge for shipping?

For orders under ₹899, we charge a flat fee of ₹99. However, if your order totals ₹ 899 or more, shipping is on us! Just a heads up: if you return an item and your order drops below ₹ 899, the shipping fee will apply.

3. When should I expect my order to be dispatched?

We typically dispatch orders within 1-2 business days after receiving them. It may take a bit longer during festive seasons, but we'll keep you updated every step of the way.

4. Do you ship internationally?

Not just yet, but we're working on it! For now, we proudly ship all across India. If you're located outside of India, hang tight—we are coming to you soon!

5. How can I track my order?

Once your order is shipped, we’ll email you a tracking code. Follow the link to track your package.

settings.question: Returns and Refunds
settings.text:
1. What is your returns & exchange policy?

For more details, please visit our Returns & Exchange page. We’ve made the process as easy as possible to ensure a hassle-free experience.

2. When will I receive my refund?

Once we receive your returned item and verify everything is in order, we’ll process your refund within 2-4 business days.

3. How do I process a return?

Simply visit our Returns & Exchange page and follow the easy steps to initiate your return.

4. Can I return sale items?

Unfortunately, sale items are considered final sale and cannot be returned. We appreciate your understanding.

settings.question: Support
settings.text:
1. What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards, including Visa, MasterCard, and American Express. For added convenience, we also offer Cash on Delivery (COD).

2. Why haven't I received an email about my order?

Let’s check a few things:

  1. Is the email address you provided correct?
  2. Have you accidentally unsubscribed from Kiggle emails?
  3. Could you please refresh your inbox and check your spam folder?

 If everything looks good and you still can't see the email, please get in touch with us at hello@kiggle.shop, and we’ll help sort it out.

3. Why can’t I check out?

If you're having trouble checking out, it might be because a required field is missing. Please double-check that all necessary information is filled in, then click the "Pay Now" button. If you’re still experiencing issues, don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to help.
